**EditCraft Intelligence Core**

Understands the selected gene, genomic assembly, transcript isoforms, variants and known functional annotations.
### B. Mechanism Selection Engine
Identifies applicable computational modalities based on the research objective and supported scientific capabilities.
### C. Model Orchestrator
Invokes appropriate prediction and analysis models through validated input/output contracts.
### D. Cross-Model Assessment
Compares compatible predictions while retaining disagreement, uncertainty and model provenance.
### E. Variant Consequence Engine
Maps predicted DNA or RNA alterations to supported transcript and protein consequences.
### F. Counterfactual Intelligence
Investigates whether predictions behave consistently with experimentally characterized functional and nonfunctional variants.
### G. Multi-Objective Decision Controller
Selects justified next analytical operations according to scientific value, uncertainty, constraints and remaining compute budget.
### H. Experimental Evidence Layer
Integrates results from real editing experiments when available.
### I. Scientific Report Generator
Produces reproducible analysis packages suitable for research documentation.
### Original research hypothesis

Investigate whether biology-guided, uncertainty-aware coordination of multiple validated models improves prediction quality, calibration, target prioritization and scientific decision-making relative to individual-model baselines.
**Do not claim that the combined engine is better until matched benchmarking demonstrates an improvement.**
